company_id.description: The hub id of the company whose jobs were looked for.

careers_url.description: The page that lists the company's open roles; null when none was found.

job_board.description: The board set with set_job_board when the roles sit on one the hub reads; null otherwise.

jobs_recorded.description: How many roles were recorded with record_company_jobs; 0 when a board serves them.
